title: Memeing
author: Trashy_io
selftext: even if only 1-5 upvotes still a win in my book XD

comments.author: Own_Principle_7901
comments.body: The easiness to make something somewhat playable sometimes bites itself. It's too easy to slop out a "game", but making a actually fun, polished and balanced game takes several days instead of several hours (better than several weeks, tho).

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: agreed Ive learned my lesson early, and I am still trying learn how to make a "great" game in terms of gameplay balance and pacing, i've gotten visuals and feel down pretty good but pacing and balance is another craft and AI should not touch when fine tuning imo
